description: ATV fleet on arrival: 1 working, 1 with a flat tyre, 1 with failed ignition, and 2 that never started this mission. Only one vehicle was operational to begin with.
response: Over 3 pre-sim days the team cannibalized tyres, swapped fuses, used starter fluid, replaced spark plugs, and charged batteries overnight. All 5 ATVs started by Day 3.
lesson: Budget 3 full days for ATV triage in pre-sim. Bring spark plugs matched to models, starter fluid, spare fuses, a tyre repair kit, and fuel conditioner. Do not start simulation until a minimum of 2 ATVs are confirmed operational.
